generalFaqs.a: We start with a free 30-minute discovery call. If there's a fit, we send a fixed-scope proposal within a week. Once accepted, kickoff is usually within 7–10 days.

generalFaqs.q: Do you work with clients outside the US?
generalFaqs.a: Yes — we are a remote-first studio and work with founders and teams worldwide. Roughly half of our clients are outside North America.
Marketing sites start at $6,800. Product engagements start at $18,000. SEO retainers start at $2,400/month. Every quote is fixed-scope so you know what you're paying for.
You do. Full IP transfer is part of every engagement. You get the source files, the repo, and a documented handover — no platform lock-in.

generalFaqs.q: Do you work with existing in-house teams?
generalFaqs.a: Often. We can pair with your engineers and designers, run the work solo, or flex between the two as needed.
We offer ongoing care plans for performance, security, and small improvements. Many clients move into a monthly retainer to keep shipping.
Typically 1–3 weeks out. We keep capacity tight on purpose so the people on your call are the people doing the work.

generalFaqs.q: Can I see references or recent work?
generalFaqs.a: Yes — our portfolio page has detailed case studies and we're happy to connect you with past clients on request.

processFaqs.q: How involved will I need to be?
processFaqs.a: We need 2–3 hours per week from a single decision-maker. Less and we slow down; more is welcome but not required.

processFaqs.q: What tools do you use to collaborate?
processFaqs.a: Figma for design, Linear or Notion for project tracking, Slack for day-to-day, and Loom for async updates.
Every phase has two structured revision rounds built in. Beyond that, we scope changes transparently.

processFaqs.q: What if we want to change scope mid-project?
processFaqs.a: Happens often. We pause, document the change, and adjust the SOW before resuming. No surprises.
Yes. Async Loom on Friday plus a 30-minute live sync. You always know what shipped and what's next.

pricingFaqs.a: No. Quotes are fixed-scope. The only variable is third-party costs (hosting, fonts, stock) which we surface upfront.
Yes. Most engagements split into 30/40/30 across kickoff, mid-project, and launch.
If we don't ship the first design milestone to your satisfaction, we refund what you've paid, full stop.

pricingFaqs.q: Can you match a fixed budget?
pricingFaqs.a: Sometimes. We'll be honest about what's realistic at a given budget instead of overpromising.

pricingFaqs.q: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
pricingFaqs.a: Yes — 15% off for registered nonprofits and a sliding scale for early-stage founders.

portfolioFaqs.q: Can I see live links to these projects?
portfolioFaqs.a: For most. A handful are under NDA — happy to walk through them on a call.

portfolioFaqs.q: What industries do you have the most experience in?
portfolioFaqs.a: SaaS, professional services, healthcare, and e-commerce in roughly that order.

portfolioFaqs.q: Do you take on small projects?
portfolioFaqs.a: Yes — landing pages, brand refreshes, and audits are often great fits.

websynerValues.title: Outcomes over deliverables
websynerValues.description: A great deck doesn't move the business. We define success in your metrics on day one and ship toward them.

websynerValues.title: Transparent by default
websynerValues.description: Live dashboards, weekly Loom updates, fixed-scope quotes. No surprise invoices, ever.

websynerValues.title: Senior, in the room
websynerValues.description: The people on your kickoff call do the work. No layered handoffs, no junior teams hidden behind a producer.

websynerValues.title: Built to be handed over
websynerValues.description: Documented code, editable CMS, recorded walkthroughs. You own the work and the knowledge.

whyChoose.title: We work in your stack
whyChoose.description: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, modern tooling. Your future engineers will thank us.

whyChoose.title: We design for performance

whyChoose.title: We measure what matters
whyChoose.description: Pipeline, signups, revenue. We don't celebrate vanity wins on your behalf.

whyChoose.title: We're built to last
whyChoose.description: Boutique by design. We turn down work that isn't a fit so the work we take stays excellent.

whyChoose.title: Senior team, every project

whyChoose.title: No platform lock-in
whyChoose.description: You own the code, the brand assets, and the documentation. Leaving us is always easy.

drivers.title: Curiosity
